title: botai achievement
description: A personal badge, awarded by a deterministic rule over recorded evidence. Off by default. There is deliberately no leaderboard, no daily streak and no penalty for pausing: those turn a study aid into something that punishes taking a break. A badge is never part of a course grade.

rule_version.description: Uniqueness is (learner, course, achievement, rule_version): a changed rule may award again, and a repeat call or a restart never does.

evidence_ids.description: The attempts or checks that justify the badge. An award with no evidence is refused at construction, the same way a mastery claim is.

revocation_reason_ru.description: Why a badge was withdrawn — for instance the evidence it rested on turned out to be wrong. Revocation is explained, never a silent removal, and never a punishment.

visibility.description: There is no `public` value. A shared badge would make the record comparative, which is the thing badges are not allowed to become here.

reason_ru.description: What was actually demonstrated, so the badge teaches something rather than merely glowing.
